name: Lena Engagement-to-Selection Policy
purpose: Translate logged engagement demand into recipe promotion pressure so audience interest can influence the next content rotations without overriding continuity guardrails.

outfit_request.notes: Outfit demand should favor looks people can ask about again, preferably outside the repeated home-proof lane.

routine_request.notes: Routine demand should favor repeatable fitness/wellness lanes before adding more mirror-only proof content.

food_question.notes: Food curiosity supports kitchen and simple lifestyle follow-ups.

flirty.notes: Flirty engagement should favor public-world charisma lanes, not repetitive apartment proof loops.

audio_question.notes: Audio curiosity is strongest on movement or reel-friendly lanes.

compliment.notes: Warmth/compliment signals can support broader public-world promotion when continuity says the account needs range.
